origin.description: Read item and description rows from a 00Index file.
origin.details: Blank lines separate chunks. A continuation line that starts with spaces joins the description.
origin.example: f <- tempfile(); writeLines(c("foo     A description", "        continued"), f); read.00Index(f)

translation.description: Read item and description rows from a 00Index file.
translation.details: Returns a list of item, description pairs.
translation.example:
import tempfile
from tools import read_00index
path = tempfile.mktemp()
open(path, "w").write("foo     A description\n        continued\n")
print(read_00index(path))
